paragraphs: There's no better way to make an entrance than in a stretch Hummer. Deluxe Limousine Service offers a fleet of premium Hummer limousines for every occasion, from birthdays and corporate events to weddings, proms, and unforgettable nights out with friends.

Whether it’s a prom, a birthday night, or a corporate celebration, our Hummer stretch limos seat up to 14 passengers with premium interiors, LED lighting, and a powerful sound system. For gatherings that need the same [Hummer limo rental Orange County](/orange/hummer-limo-rental/) impact across the county, we offer an equally impressive fleet.

Every Hummer rental is delivered spotless, fully stocked with refreshments, and driven by a professional chauffeur who knows the best routes around Anaheim and beyond. Pair the Hummer with a [party bus rental near Anaheim](/anaheim/party-bus-rental/) when your group outgrows even the stretch SUV.
